newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico labor boss Velazquez takes turn for worse.
newsitem.headline: Mexico labor boss Velazquez takes turn for worse.

text.p: Veteran Mexican labor leader Fidel Velazquez has taken a turn for the worse in hospital, and doctors are carrying out new tests, Televisa reported in its 24 Horas television news program on Thursday.
It said Velazquez, 97, has been diagnosed with anemia, and ran a high fever on Wednesday. He was due to leave hospital this week, but doctors decided that was not now possible.

Televisa quoted top officials of Velazquez's six-million-strong Mexican Workers Confederation (CTM) as saying they would not yet consider a possible successor to Velazquez, who for 60 years has been Mexico's main union boss and a pillar of support for the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party.
He has been in and out of hospital this year, and is considered very frail.
